theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : Set.Finite (range f) :=
    ((finite_Icc B T).prod ((finite_Icc B T).prod ((finite_Icc B T).prod (finite_Icc B T)))).subset
      (range_subset_iff.mpr fun n => ⟨hB n, hB (n + 1), hB (n + 2), hB (n + 3)⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! hc
    exact (not_infinite.mpr hfin) (infinite_range_of_injective fun a b hab => (Nat.lt_trichotomy a b).elim
      (fun hh => (hc a b hh hab).elim) fun hh => hh.elim id fun hh' => (hc b a hh' hab.symm).elim)
  obtain ⟨c, rfl, hc⟩ : ∃ c, j = i + c ∧ 0 < c := ⟨j - i, by omega, by omega⟩
  have hf (n : ℕ) : (u (n + 4) : ℝ) = (u (n + 3) + u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) * u n) / (u (n + 3) * u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) + u n) :=
    (hu (n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left 4 n)).1
  have H : ∀ k : ℕ, f (i + k) = f (i + c + k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact h
    | succ k ih =>
      simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih ⊢
      have e : (u (i + k + 4) : ℝ) = (u (i + c + k + 4) : ℝ) := by rw [hf, hf, ih.1, ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2]
      exact ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, Int.cast_inj.1 e⟩
  refine ⟨i, c, hc, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  convert (congrArg Prod.fst (H (n - i))).symm using 2 <;> omega
